blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Iterative MRI reconstructors produce intermediate estimates before returning a final image. We study these inference trajectories as a model-internal representation of realized reconstruction risk, measured by log-NMSE. Model-native states are projected to magnitude images, summarized by a fixed 16-dimensional descriptor, and mapped to risk using a source-trained ridge readout. Across three reconstruction backbones, trajectory features are strongly predictive of reconstruction risk on held-out source data. Under zero-shot target shift, their behavior is backbone-dependent, exhibiting both preserved positive association and readout reversal. Conditional analyses show that trajectory information can remain associated with error beyond an initialization-only predictor. A prefix analysis further shows that useful trajectory information can emerge before reconstruction completes. Repeated-mask and low-shot calibration studies indicate that trajectories primarily encode persistent case difficulty, while their orientation and calibration can change under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 活性核磁共振重建器在还原出最终图像之前会产生中间估计. 我们研究这些推论轨迹,作为以对数NMSE衡量的已实现重建风险的内部模型。 模型-原生状态预测成比例图像,由固定的16维描述图加以归纳,并采用经源培训的山脊读取法绘制成风险图。 纵观三个重建主干线,轨迹特征对被搁置来源数据的重建风险有强烈的预测. 在零镜头目标转变下,他们的行为依赖骨干,既表现出保留了正联想,也显示出了读出倒转. 有条件的分析表明,轨迹信息可能仍然与超出初始化-仅能预测的误差有关. 前缀分析进一步表明,在重建完成之前,可以出现有用的轨迹信息. 重复的mask和低射校正研究显示,轨迹主要编码持续的案例难度,而它们的取向和校正可以在域移下改变.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging reduces scan time by measuring part of k k -space and reconstructing the missing information computationally. Parallel imaging and compressed sensing provide established formulations for this inverse problem [ 20 , 10 , 17 ] . Learned reconstruction methods combine trainable priors with the MRI forward model and data consistency [ 11 , 1 , 23 , 21 , 26 , 27 ] . These methods can return visually plausible images with structured residual error. Deployment therefore requires a case-level estimate of reconstruction error when the fully sampled reference is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 加速磁共振成像通过测量 kk - 空间的一部分并计算重建缺失的信息来减少扫描时间. 平行成像和压缩遥感为这一反向问题提供了既定配方[20、10、17]。 学到的重建方法将可训练的前科与核磁共振前期模型和数据一致性相结合[11、1、23、21、26、27]。 这些方法可以以结构化的剩余误差返回视觉上可信的图像。 因此,在没有完全抽样的参考文献时,部署需要就重建错误作出个案一级的估计。

blocks.en: Fully sampled references are generally unavailable at inference. Existing risk estimators use the final reconstruction, stochastic predictions, learned error maps, ensembles, or calibrated interval widths [ 12 , 5 , 14 , 13 , 22 , 2 ] . Strong final-image predictors can estimate reconstruction error. Iterative reconstructors also expose a sequence of internal estimates that records how the model reached its output. This sequence provides a separate source of evidence about update magnitude, convergence shape, cancellation, and motion near the endpoint. Trajectory statistics can also become available before reconstruction finishes, enabling early triage.
blocks.zh: 通常无法推断出完整的抽样参考。 现有的风险估计器使用最终重建,线条预测,学到的错误地图,组合,或校准间隔宽度[12,5,14,13,22,2]. 强大的最终图像预测器可以估计重建错误. 迭代重建器还暴露出一系列内部估计,记录模型如何达到输出. 此序列为更新的体积,趋同形状,取消,以及末端附近的运动提供了单独的证据来源. 在重建完成之前也可以获得轨迹统计,从而可以及早进行分解。

blocks.en: A controlled-corruption study first showed that intermediate-state geometry changes reproducibly with degradation severity while failing a causal correction probe. This separation motivates an observational risk estimator. Full directional and intervention analyses are provided in Supplementary Sec. S10.
blocks.zh: 一项受控腐败研究首先显示,中间状态几何变化随着退化的严重程度而发生再现,同时未能进行因果校正探测。 这种分离刺激了一个观察风险估计器。 补充S10中提供了全面的定向和干预分析。

blocks.en: We project the native states of an iterative MRI reconstructor to a common image space and summarize the resulting path with 16 pre-specified geometric features. A low-capacity ridge model maps these features to log-NMSE. The main generality experiment applies exactly the same descriptor and evaluation protocol across three substantially different iterative reconstruction backbones on matched fastMRI-brain source data and M4Raw target data. It compares trajectory risk with a Hu-style final-image error predictor, a scalar final-image predictor, conformalized uncertainty scores, an initialization-only control, and inexpensive physics-side diagnostics. The target evaluation is zero-shot. Risk models are fitted on source data, and M4Raw labels are used only for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们将一个迭代核磁共振重建器的原生状态投射到一个共同的图像空间,并以16个预先指定的几何特征来总结由此产生的路径。 低容量的山脊模型将这些特性映射到log-NMSE. 主要的通用性实验在匹配的快速MRI-大脑源数据和M4Raw目标数据上,在三个大相径庭的迭代重建主干线上适用完全相同的描述和评价协议. 它将轨迹风险与Hu型最终图像误差预测器,斯卡尔式最终图像预测器,可调节的不确定性分数,仅初始化控制,以及廉价的物理侧诊断进行对比. 目标评价为零镜头. 风险模型安装在源数据上,M4Raw标签仅用于评价.

blocks.en: The results separate representation informativeness from readout transfer. All three trajectory predictors are strong on held-out source data. Under zero-shot target shift, one readout retains strong positive association, one remains positive but attenuated, and one reverses during severe reconstruction shift. Initialization and endpoint controls show that trajectory information can remain conditionally associated with error. A prefix experiment supplies most target ranking information by iteration 12 of 25. A repeated-mask experiment further shows that the trajectory mainly measures persistent case difficulty across physical volumes. Affine target readouts recover useful prediction from reversed coordinates in two stress tests.
blocks.zh: 结果将说明信息与读出转让分开。 所有三种轨迹预测器都对搁置源数据很强. 在零镜头目标转移下,一个读出保留了很强的正向联系,一个读出保持正向但减弱,一个读出在严重重建转移时出现反向. 初始化和端点控制显示,轨迹信息仍可有条件地与错误相关联. 一个前缀实验通过第12版25集提供大多数目标排名信息. 一次重复的面具实验进一步表明,轨迹主要测量物理体积的持久性病例难度. Affine目标读数在两次压力测试中从反向坐标中恢复有用的预测.

blocks.en: The paper makes three contributions. First, it defines a compact image-space trajectory representation shared across three substantially different iterative reconstruction backbones. Second, it evaluates this representation against initialization, learned final-image, uncertainty, and physics-side controls under a matched source and target protocol. Third, it shows that trajectory risk mainly reflects persistent case difficulty, can become informative before inference completes, and can retain target-risk structure after domain shift changes its source-trained orientation.
blocks.zh: 该文件作出了三项贡献。 首先,它界定了三个截然不同的迭代重建主干线共享的紧凑的图像-空间轨迹代表。 第二,它对照初始化、学到的最后图像、不确定性和物理方面的控制,在匹配的源和目标协议下评估这种表述。 第三,它表明,轨迹风险主要反映持续的案例困难,在推论完成前可以成为信息,在域移改变其源培训方向后可以保留目标风险结构.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Learned iterative reconstruction. Unrolled networks translate iterations of an optimization procedure into trainable stages. Variational networks learn regularization within a variational update [ 11 ] . MoDL alternates learned regularization with model-based data consistency [ 1 ] . E2E-VarNet integrates sensitivity estimation and multi-coil reconstruction [ 23 ] . XPDNet is a primal-dual-inspired cross-domain unrolled reconstruction network [ 21 ] . PromptMR exploits adjacent context through prompted reconstruction modules [ 26 ] , while PromptMR+ enhances gradient and information flow within and across unrolled stages and improves adjacent-information-based sensitivity estimation [ 27 ] . These architectures expose intermediate estimates during their standard forward pass. We study the geometry of those estimates as a risk modality.
blocks.zh: 学会了迭代重建。 未滚动网络将优化程序的迭代转化为可训练阶段。 变异网络在变异更新中学习规范化[11]. 国防部候补人员学习了基于模型的数据一致性规范化[1]. E2E-VarNet整合了敏感性估计和多油重建[23]. XPDNet是一个初创双创的跨域未滚动重建网络[21]. 提示 MR通过提示重建模块利用相邻的上下文 [26],同时 迅速 MR+增强未滚动阶段内和之间的梯度和信息流动,并改进以相邻信息为基础的敏感性估计[27]。 这些架构在标准前传期间暴露了中间估计. 我们研究这些估计的几何学作为一种风险模式。

blocks.en: Uncertainty and error prediction. Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles approximate predictive uncertainty through repeated inference [ 8 , 16 ] . MRI methods include variational uncertainty, deep ensembles under acquisition shifts, and parameter-posterior sampling [ 5 , 14 , 13 ] . SURE and generalized SURE estimate expected risk through assumptions on the measurement process [ 24 , 6 ] . Hu et al. propose a two-step framework that separately trains a reconstruction model and an error-prediction model [ 12 ] . DEUP studies secondary error prediction from out-of-sample errors [ 15 ] . Our target is the realized scalar error of one deterministic reconstruction. The contribution lies in using solver dynamics as the predictor input and in testing whether they add information beyond strong endpoint models.
blocks.zh: 不确定和错误预测。 蒙特卡洛辍学和深层组合通过反复推论大致预测不确定性[8,16]. 核磁共振方法包括变异不确定性、获取转移时的深聚物和参数前取样[5、14、13]。 通过对计量过程的假设,确定和普遍确定估计预期风险[24、6]。 胡等提出两步框架,分别训练重建模型和误差预测模型[12]. DEUP研究从样本外错误中得出次级错误预测[15]. 我们的目标是一次决定性重建的已意识到的大规模错误。 其贡献在于将解析器动态作为预测器输入,以及测试它们是否在强端点模型之外添加信息.

blocks.en: Calibration and distribution shift. Conformalized quantile regression constructs marginal prediction intervals from a labeled calibration set [ 22 ] . Risk-controlling methods extend calibration to image-valued outputs and general losses [ 2 , 3 ] . Imaging applications include conformal bounds for full-reference quality metrics [ 25 ] . Giannakopoulos et al. construct pixel-wise uncertainty intervals for accelerated MRI reconstruction [ 9 ] , while our objective is one scalar realized case-level risk coordinate from deterministic solver dynamics. Reconstruction robustness studies report sensitivity to anatomy, contrast, acceleration, masks, and noise [ 4 , 7 ] . We hold each reconstructor fixed and distinguish the trajectory representation from the scalar readout that interprets it. This distinction is evaluated directly through signed zero-shot transfer and low-shot target calibration.
blocks.zh: 校准与分配班次. 形式化的量子回归从标签化的校准集[22]中构建边际预测间隔. 风险控制方法将校准扩大到图像值输出和一般损失[2,3]. 成像应用包括完全参考质量衡量标准的统一界限[25]。 Giannakopoulos 等人为加速核磁共振重建构建了像素-视星等的不确定性间隔[9],而我们的目标是从确定性解析器动态中形成一个已实现的分级风险坐标。 重建坚固性研究报告了对解剖、对比、加速、面具和噪音的敏感性[4、7]。 我们把每个重建器固定 并区分轨迹代表 和解释它的标尺读数。 这种区分直接通过签名的零射转射和低射目标校准来评价.

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparators and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 比较和评价

blocks.en: We compare the trajectory readout with four source-trained estimators. Our Hu-style comparator adapts the two-step error-prediction idea of Hu et al. to a final-reconstruction input [ 12 ] . Its pooled error-map magnitude is used as a case-level score. ResNet maps the final magnitude image directly to scalar log-NMSE. CQR fits lower and upper image quantiles and uses normalized mean calibrated interval width [ 2 , 22 ] . RM-RMS uses normalized RMS residual-magnitude interval width following image-to-image risk control [ 2 ] . CQR and RM-RMS are evaluated as risk scores through correlation with log-NMSE. We also evaluate endpoint amplitude and the final sampled-space data-consistency residual as inexpensive controls.

blocks.en: 4.1 Matched Evaluation Protocol

blocks.en: The matched source dataset is fastMRI brain [ 19 ] . It contains 3676 evaluated slices, with 2944 source-fit rows from 736 patients and 732 held-out rows from 183 patients. Four central slices are evaluated per volume. The target dataset is M4Raw FLAIR [ 18 ] , with 400 slices from 100 scans and 25 patients. Four slices are averaged into each scan-level target score before patient-cluster evaluation. XPDNet, VarNet, and PromptMR+ use the same selected volumes, slices, mask semantics, risk target, and 16 feature definitions.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The matched experiment makes architecture the main varying factor by holding the cohorts, slices, mask semantics, risk target, and feature functions fixed. Source trajectory correlations occupy a narrow high range, while target correlations span − 0.935 -0.935 to 0.856 0.856 . Image-space solver geometry contains substantial risk structure across the evaluated reconstructors, while the source coefficient vector does not define an invariant orientation under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 匹配的实验通过持有组别,切片,面具语义,风险目标,和特征函数固定,使架构成为主要的不同因素. 源轨迹相关性占据了狭窄的高范围,而目标相关性则从0.935-0.935到0.856 0.856。 图像-空间解析器几何中包含着整个被评价的重建器的实质性风险结构,而源系数矢量并没有定义域位移下的不变量方向.

blocks.en: The comparator matrix clarifies the role of this modality. PromptMR+ trajectories retain most conditional association after controlling for Hu-style. XPDNet trajectories and Hu-style predictions both retain conditional association, and their source-only fusion improves target performance. VarNet trajectory and RM-RMS reverse, while CQR and the data-consistency residual remain positively associated. Solver dynamics therefore provide distinct evidence whose relative value depends on the reconstruction backbone and shift.
blocks.zh: 参照国汇总表澄清了这一模式的作用。 提示 MR+轨迹在控制Hu风格后保留了大多数有条件的关联. XPDNet的轨迹和Hu风格的预测都保留了有条件的关联,其仅源的聚变可以提高目标性能. VarNet轨迹和RM-RMS反向,而CQR和数据一致性的剩余部分仍然保持积极的联系. 因此,解决动态提供了明确的证据,其相对价值取决于重建的骨干和转变。

blocks.en: The initialization and repeated-mask controls refine what the trajectory represents. On source data, the learned initialization-only control has little independent association once the trajectory is known. Under target shift, initialization can become strongly informative, consistent with increased input-visible case difficulty, while the trajectory remains substantially and independently associated with error. The repeated-mask experiment further shows that, under that protocol, most trajectory signal reflects persistent differences between cases rather than fine variation among nearby sampling masks. We therefore interpret inference trajectories as a model-internal representation of case-level reconstruction difficulty that can retain information beyond a learned initialization-only score, rather than as a universally dynamics-exclusive measure of error.
blocks.zh: 初始化和重复掩埋控制使轨迹更加精炼。 在源数据上,一旦知道轨迹,所学的初始化-只控制几乎没有独立的关联. 在目标转变下,初始化可随着输入-可见案例难度的增加而变得信息灵通,而轨迹仍然与错误有实质性和独立的联系. 重复面具试验进一步表明,根据该规程,大多数轨迹信号反映了病例之间的持续差异,而不是附近取样面具之间的细微差异。 因此,我们把推论轨迹解释为对案例一级重建困难的一种示范性内部反映,这种反映可以将信息保留在只学到的初始化分数之外,而不是对错误的一种普遍动态的排他性衡量。

blocks.en: Patient centering does not remove acquisition-level structure. In a separate earlier XPDNet transfer analysis, patient-and-acquisition adjustment reduced the pooled target slope from 1.560 1.560 to 0.0935 0.0935 in Supplementary Sec. S9. The matched within-patient correlations show that the associations are not explained solely by differences between patients, although acquisition-level variation remains. The VarNet reversal also persists under the scale-invariant and initialization controls, but its origin remains unclear.
blocks.zh: 患者中心化不会移除获取级结构. 在先前的XPDNet转移分析中,病人和收购调整将集合目标坡度从补充塞克的1.5601.560降至0.09350.0935。 第9节。 病人内部的对应关系表明,这些联系并非完全由病人之间的差异来解释,尽管获得层面的差异依然存在。 VarNet在规模变化和初始化控制下也持续存在,但其来源仍不清楚。

blocks.en: Correlation and RMSE answer different deployment questions. Positive rank association can support triage after monotone target calibration, while absolute risk thresholds require correct offset and scale. PromptMR+ illustrates this distinction through high zero-shot correlation and weaker source-scale RMSE. VarNet fails signed ordering and calibration. The matched VarNet and independent PromptMR experiments show that two target parameters can recover calibrated prediction when the frozen coordinate remains ordered. Such repair requires labeled target data, since a readout reversal cannot be identified from the source score alone. Their different split designs are reported in Supplementary Secs. S7 and S9 and do not support a general sample-complexity claim.
blocks.zh: 关联和RMSE回答不同的部署问题. 正阶关联可以在单调目标校准后支持分级,而绝对风险阈值则需要正确的抵消和规模. 提示 MR+通过高零射线相关性和弱源级RMSE来说明这种区别. VarNet 无法签名订购和校准 。 匹配的VarNet和独立的PowerMR实验显示,在定下冷冻坐标时,有两个目标参数可以恢复校准的预测. 这种修复需要贴上标签的目标数据,因为仅从源分数无法识别读出逆转. 其不同的拆分设计在补充分类中报告. S7和S9, 不支持一般的抽样复杂索赔。

blocks.en: The descriptor reuses one deterministic reconstruction and applies a 16-feature linear readout. Early prediction has been demonstrated only for XPDNet, and wall-clock costs were not compared across the differently instrumented methods. The PromptMR+ scalar ResNet also shows seed sensitivity, so endpoint conclusions rely on the broader comparator and conditional analyses.
blocks.zh: 描述符重用一个定型重建,并应用16度线性读出. 早期的预测只显示在XPDNet上,没有用不同的仪器方法比较墙点成本。 PowerMR+scalar ResNet也显示出种子敏感性,因此端点结论依赖于更广泛的比较者和有条件的分析.

blocks.en: The evaluation covers three backbones, one source dataset, one M4Raw FLAIR cohort, fixed nominal acceleration, and log-NMSE. The repeated-mask analysis uses the earlier discovery-model descriptor and nearby masks. Future work should test additional anatomies, field strengths, accelerations, sampling patterns, and clinically weighted targets. Prospective studies should evaluate review decisions, instrumentation cost, and target-efficient orientation diagnosis and calibration.
blocks.zh: 评价涵盖3个主干网、1个源数据集、1个M4Raw FLAIR组、固定名义加速度和对数NMSE。 重复面具分析使用早期的发现模型描述符和附近的面具. 今后的工作应测试额外的解剖、实地优势、加速、取样模式和临床加权目标。 前瞻性研究应当评价审查决定,仪器成本,以及目标高效的定向诊断和校准.

blocks.en: The source cohort contains 3676 fastMRI-brain slices. Source fitting uses 2944 rows from 736 patients, and held-out evaluation uses 732 rows from 183 patients. Four central slices remain grouped within each volume. The M4Raw FLAIR target contains 400 slices from 100 scans and 25 patients. Four selected slices are averaged to scan level before target correlation and patient resampling.

blocks.en: Feature normalization, ridge selection, and all comparator fitting use source data. No M4 label is used for fitting, model selection, orientation correction, or calibration in the matched zero-shot study. The bootstrap uses 10,000 replicates with seed 20260828. The source independent unit is the patient, with 183 held-out patients and 732 slices. The M4Raw independent unit is the patient, with 25 patients. M4Raw predictions are first aggregated to 100 FLAIR-scan scores before resampling. Percentile confidence intervals use the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles. Paired comparisons apply the same patient resample to both methods.
blocks.zh: 特性正常化、山脊选择以及所有参照物的配置都使用源数据。 在匹配的零镜头研究中,没有M4标签用于配装,模型选择,定向校正,或校准. 该靴子使用10 000枚复制品,种子为20260828。 来源独立的单位是病人,有183名被搁置的病人和732片切片. M4Raw独立单元是患者,有25名患者. M4Raw的预测首先汇总到100个FLAIR-scan分数,然后再进行复制. 百分位置信间隔使用2.5和97.5百分位. Paired比较对两种方法都适用同样的病人再现.

blocks.en: Trajectory is the source-only ridge predictor of log-NMSE from the generic descriptor. Our Hu-style comparator adapts the two-step error-prediction idea of Hu et al. to a final-reconstruction input [ 12 ] . ResNet is a learned final-image scalar log-NMSE predictor. CQR is normalized mean prediction-interval width [ 2 , 22 ] . RM-RMS is normalized RMS residual-magnitude interval width following image-to-image risk control [ 2 ] . The XPDNet RMS-normalized CQR width is retained as a secondary score in Sec. F . The primary CQR result always uses mean-normalized width.
blocks.zh: 轨迹是通用描述符中仅来自源的log-NMSE的山脊预测器. 我们的胡式比较器将胡等人的两步误差预测思想调整为最终重建输入[12]. ResNet是一个学习过的最终图像scalarlog-NMSE预测器. CQR是正常的中间预测-间距宽度[2,22]. RM-RMS在图像到图像风险控制之后,RMS的剩余宽度是正常的。 XPDNet RMS规范化的CQR宽度作为二级分数保留在Sec. F. 主CQR结果总是使用正态宽度.

blocks.en: For the VarNet and PromptMR+ transfer analyses, we additionally evaluate endpoint amplitude and the final sampled-space data-consistency residual as inexpensive diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 就VarNet和SuperMR+转移分析而言,我们进一步评价端点振幅和最后抽样空间数据一致性残留作为廉价诊断。

blocks.en: RMSE is meaningful for calibrated point predictors such as trajectory, Hu-style, and ResNet. CQR and RM-RMS are interval-width risk scores, so the main comparison reports their signed correlation with log-NMSE. Fusion is analyzed separately because the XPDNet model uses a meta-out-of-fold construction, while the VarNet and PromptMR+ stacks are less strictly cross-fitted. Complementarity claims for VarNet and PromptMR+ therefore use partial correlations.
blocks.zh: RMSE对轨迹,Hu型,ResNet等校准点预测器具有意义. CQR和RM-RMS是间隔宽风险分数,因此主比较报告它们与log-NMSE的签名相关性. Fusion被单独分析,因为XPDNet模型使用元外置构造,而VarNet和FournalMR+堆栈的截面不太严格. 因此,VarNet和PowerMR+的互补性索赔使用了部分相关性。

blocks.en: The pilot supports an observational interpretation. Intermediate paths can encode degradation severity even when their tangent provides no useful loss-reduction direction. The MRI estimator reads the trajectory as evidence about risk and makes no intervention claim.

blocks.en: The matched study covers three reconstruction backbones, one source dataset, one target dataset, fixed nominal acceleration, and log-NMSE risk. It does not establish universal zero-shot transfer. PromptMR+, XPDNet, and VarNet show positive, attenuated, and reversed readouts under the same target protocol. Physics-side residuals can dominate under some shifts. Prospective deployment therefore requires signed target validation and, when labels are available, calibration at the patient level.
